subject.title: feat(agents)!: remove the stored default agent — sole agent or explicit ownership

question: Is the submitted real-world evidence sufficient to merge a migration that changes agent ownership for existing multi-agent fleets, or should maintainers require an inspectable legacy-upgrade transcript on the rebased head?
rationale: The branch changes persisted configuration, credential inheritance, session ownership, channel routing, and Gateway compatibility; CI and unit evidence are supplemental but do not directly demonstrate the proposed upgrade outcome.

options.title: Require rebased upgrade proof
options.body: Require redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a legacy multi-agent config is migrated, its former owner remains effective, and a new ownerless route fails with the documented action.

options.title: Accept the stated test matrix
options.body: Merge based on the reported Testbox and CI matrix, accepting that no inspectable real migration transcript is attached.

recommendation.title: Require rebased upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a legacy multi-agent config is migrated, its former owner remains effective, and a new ownerless route fails with the documented action.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the prior ownership migration and this follow-up, making them the strongest available routing contact for the evidence and upgrade boundary.
